task: I want a report (the folder must be written in the appropriate path/location) about all the possible edge cases that can happen during the member transfer process.

findings.title: Duplicate numbering in summary section
findings.detail: Lines 272 and 275 both use number 6. SEC-01 is 6, T-11 should be 7, and CFG-08 should be 8. This is a cosmetic numbering error in the Summary of Critical Edge Cases section.

findings.title: T-035 trigger description is inaccurate
findings.detail: T-035 trigger says 'Account is blocked by the dest group or vice versa' but UserIsBlockedError means the target user has blocked the account (bot), not that the dest group blocked it. The phrasing implies group-level restriction which is incorrect.

findings.title: DB-04 impact description is misleading
findings.detail: DB-04 impact says 'unhandled exception could prevent account slot cleanup in the _finalize finally block.' Python's finally block always runs — _run_job lines 369-374 execute regardless of exceptions. The real impact is a lost audit trail entry, not prevented slot cleanup.
